  3. Municipal Parking

Municipal Parking

The Borough has municipal parking lots for public use in the following locations:

  • Upper Municipal Parking Lot (behind Borough Hall)
  • Library Municipal Parking Lot (adjacent to Oradell Free Public Library, between Oradell Avenue and Church Street)
  • Schirra Park Municipal Parking Lot (adjacent to Schirra Park, between Oradell Avenue and Veldran Avenue)
  • Veterans Memorial Building / Senior Center Municipal Parking Lot (behind United States Post Office, adjacent to Senior Center)
  • World War I Memorial Municipal Parking Lot (north of Oradell Avenue and east of the railroad right-of-way)
  • Meyerhoff Municipal Parking Lot (on Kinderkamack Road between Mackay Avenue and Meyerhoff Place)
  • Pyle Street / Lake Avenue Municipal Parking Lot (adjacent to Lake Avenue, behind row of stores)
  • Park Avenue Municipal Parking Lot (adjacent to Park Avenue, behind Citgo Service Station)
  • Waite Place Municipal Parking Lot (east of Kinderkamack Road and north of Waite Place)

Please note: Time limits and other regulations for specific parking lots can be found in the Borough Codes. See Borough Code §165-10. No overnight parking is permitted in any Borough parking lot unless the vehicle has a special overnight parking sticker. All parking permits are issued by the Oradell Police Department. Call 201-261-0200 for more information about permits and application procedures.
